analysis.narrativeEn:

· Significantly below SMA100($121.39)/SMA200($123.80): Mid-to-long term trend weakened

[Momentum Indicators]

[Support & Resistance]

· Swing Resistance ($57.78): First resistance zone for short-term rebounds

[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase): Exploring direction through sideways movement, consider buying on breakout above $57.78
